body: Third instance of the stale-tip collision family (see the 2026-10-28 Zuri S008 flaw entry), with a new variant worth recording: the line resumed from a conversation summary, then read office memory (STATE, current.md, sessions) from a STALE LOCAL CHECKOUT - so the stale disk made the stale memories look live-verified. The resume sequence felt protocol-clean (memories were read before acting) but the fetch came last, after the claim. Lesson generalized: on a resumed/parallelized line, git fetch + board re-read is step zero, BEFORE reading ledger memories - a ledger on a stale checkout is itself a stale memory. Behavioral fix adopted here; pushing the fetch-first step into the resume runbook is the owner's call.
